title: The Three Garments and the Descent into Members
description: T30 describes the three accommodations by which the Lord's operative power orders the natural — wearing thought, love, and truth-in-the-natural-degree as garments fitted to the rational. He works through these to subordinate disordered productions, then strips the garments off, leaving the rational standing upright; what was claimed is scattered for purification and what is purified is conveyed upward to the height. T31 traces how the Lord's call descends into every degree of the soul: every member hangs from the head, and the Divine Human is the head from which the rational in its five degrees hangs as members. The five faculties — mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection — are sent out as one purpose of his heart after the soul-life that has slackened and scattered, to gather it back into the image of the Father.
